mentions.name: Maggielab
mentions.description: An online, non-destructive, simple image editor that aims to be approachable for people who find typical image editors difficult to use.
mentions.problem: Existing image editors are too complicated for casual, non-technical users.
mentions.audience: Made for the author's wife, who struggles to use conventional image editors.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been playing/building Maggielab.com an online, non-destructive, simple image editor. Made it for my wife because she really doesn't play well with image editors :D
